title: Cauliflower and Cheese Schnitzel
subtitle: with mustard and nutmeg
description: Crumbed cauliflower patties made with feta and mozzarella, with a hint of mustard and nutmeg, fried until golden like a classic schnitzel. The mixture can be made ahead and kept in the fridge for up to 3 days.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to the boil. Blanch the cauliflower florets for 3 minutes and remove with a slotted spoon. Do not overcook, so the cauliflower keeps a bite.

Chop the cauliflower and place in a bowl. Add the beaten eggs, flour, feta, mozzarella, salt, pepper, mustard and nutmeg and mix well by hand (or pulse in a food processor, taking care not to make a puree). If too wet add a little flour, if too dry add another egg. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to set.
With wet hands, shape the mixture into flat patties about 6-7 cm long. Coat each in breadcrumbs and place on a tray.
Heat 2 cm of olive oil in a wide, deep pan over medium heat for 3-4 minutes. Fry one schnitzel as a test, taste and adjust the seasoning. Fry the rest for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel and serve hot.
